subject: Intro to VP/CTO + schedule technical deep dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acmehealth.com>, Dr. Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + VP/CTO intro request

Hi Alicia / Samir,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: AcmeHealth is prioritizing faster inference for chart summarization (low latency for interactive clinician workflows) and stricter data access controls for PHI. We covered the high-level fit and performance expectations, next recommended step is a short exec alignment (VP/CTO) so we can unblock procurement and schedule a technical deep dive with our solutions engineer.

Proposed next steps:
- Intro call between your VP of Engineering / CTO and our CTO (15–20m) to align on compliance, deployment options (Private/VPC vs Dedicated), and high-level SLOs.
- Technical deep dive/demo (45–60m) with our solutions engineer to go through latency numbers, KV cache behavior, and a tailored demo using a redacted sample dataset.

Suggested times (PDT):
- Wednesday 4/12 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Thursday 4/13 09:00–09:30 or 11:00–11:30

I've attached a one-page demo agenda and a short list of items Samir mentioned we should prepare. Ethan, can you own the technical deep dive once we lock exec time?

Thanks, looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0163

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the recap. Samir and I are aligned, the executive intro makes sense to accelerate procurement. Our VP of Engineering, Priya Natarajan, is available for a short intro on Thursday 4/13 11:00–11:30 PDT. If that works for your CTO, please send calendar invite.

For the technical deep dive, Samir would like to see a short demo focusing on:
- End-to-end latency with live KV cache (50–512 token flows)
- How private deployments handle PHI and key management
- Cost model for dedicated vs hosted with predictable SLOs

I'll also attach the internal priority doc after loop with procurement.

Thanks,
Alicia
